name: Panel row draft and label split

pr.title: Color a drawer row's number by draft state and its word by labels alone
pr.head: 8e92848fb472c86f95553477facaf0d57c282308

summary: Projector's panel in Claude Code lists the pull requests a session fixes or reviews, one row each. Each row starts with the pull request's number, then a short word about its review, then the title. Before this change that word folded two facts into one: whether the pull request is a draft, and which review labels it carries. It printed the first of reviewing, draft, clean, and ready that applied.

That order hid a sign-off. On main, a draft means its author is still working, and the clean label means a review signed the current head off. A held draft, which is a signed-off pull request whose author is building a change on it, keeps clean, but the row printed draft because the draft check came first.
The change gives each fact its own place on the row:

• The number shows the draft state. It is drawn dim while the pull request is a draft and in the default color once it is ready for review.
  • The word shows the labels alone. It is reviewing in yellow while a review runs, clean in green once a review signed the head off, and absent before any review.

The collapsed line, such as + #12 #14, has only numbers, so it keeps its colors: red when a conflict, a change request, or failing checks hold the pull request back, green for a ready pull request labeled clean, and yellow otherwise.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Row: one pull request's line in the panel.
  • Review label: the reviewing or clean GitHub label that project review setup and project review publish manage.
  • Held draft: a pull request a review signed off, converted back to a draft while its author builds a change.
  • Dim: the dimColor prop on the number's Button, which draws it faint at rest and full strength under the pointer or the focus.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One Projector review at 8e92848, clean, with no finding threads.
  • It listed two documentation suggestions: say that the collapsed line is green for clean without reviewing, and call the word "review label" in the two lines of docs/plugins.md and the one code comment that still say "review state".

groups.title: The row's number and word
groups.kicker: How the panel draws a pull request's draft state and review labels
intro: The row is drawn in hooks/register.tsx. reviewLabel, which replaces reviewState, reads only the pull request's labels and returns no word when neither review label is present. The draft state moves to the number's Button as dimColor.
statusColor, which colors the collapsed line, gives the same color as before for every combination of draft state and labels. It now spells out the draft check that reviewState used to make for it.

files.note: Splits the row's review word from its draft state: reviewLabel reads labels only, and the number dims on a draft.

checks.text: Labels arrive lowercased from toPullRequest in hooks/github.ts, so a Reviewing label still matches. Traced the parse and the existing fixture for pull request 14.
Walked each combination of draft state and labels through the old reviewState color and the new expression. Only a ready pull request whose word is clean is green in both.
dimColor is a documented Button prop in Claude Code's declarations, and hooks/typecheck.sh passes. A loading row has isDraft: false from loadingOf, so it is not dimmed.

files.note: Rewrites the row test to check the word, its color, and whether the number is dim, for four pull requests.

checks.text: Removing dimColor={pr.isDraft} turns the test red with isDim: false for the held draft. The test still looks for draft and ready beside each title, so the old words coming back also fail it.

groups.title: The panel's documentation
groups.kicker: The plugin guide's description of a row and of the collapsed line
intro: docs/plugins.md describes the row and the collapsed line. The change rewrites both descriptions and drops the draft word from the two example panels, keeping their column widths.

files.note: Describes the dim number and the label-only word, and the collapsed line's colors.

checks.text: "Carries only the clean label" means clean without reviewing. A pull request with an unrelated label, such as bug, is still green. The review listed rewording this as a suggestion.
Two unchanged lines, about the loading row and where the drawer starts, still call the word the "review state". The review listed renaming them as a suggestion.
